description: This file defines the EntityDataService class, which manages subscriptions and data retrieval for entity data in the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for preparing, starting, stopping subscriptions, and creating subscription options, utilizing external services and models.

classes.name: EntityDataService
classes.description: Service class for managing entity data subscriptions and data loading in Thingsboard.

methods.name: prepareSubscription
methods.description: Prepares and initiates a data subscription for a given listener, returning an observable of the load result.

methods.name: startSubscription
methods.description: Starts an existing subscription, applying timewindow and offset configurations.

methods.name: subscribeForPaginatedData
methods.description: Sets up a paginated data subscription with specific page link and key filters.

methods.name: createSubscriptionOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration options for data subscriptions based on datasource and filters.
